title: Build a Web3 App - Part 4 - How to Freeze a Token or NFT
summary: Learn how to freeze and unfreeze NFTs and tokens. This is perfect for builders creating apps with soul-bound assets.
author: Carter Razink
body:
Join Carter Razink, CEO and Co-founder of DropChain, as he guides you through a comprehensive tutorial on how to freeze and unfreeze tokens, NFTs, or any asset using DropChain’s innovative tools and API. Whether you're building a Web3 app, an NFT, or a game, understanding how to manage asset control is crucial. Carter demonstrates the process of minting an NFT, sending it to another user, freezing it to restrict its movement, and subsequently unfreezing it, all without needing in-depth knowledge about smart contracts.
